description:
Step into this captivating top floor, 2-bedroom, 2-bathroom haven in the heart of Nashville's dynamic Midtown district with expansive balcony. This residence offers a blend of luxury and comfort, providing an ideal retreat for your Nashville getaway. With sophisticated touches, top-notch amenities, and proximity to iconic attractions, Your stay invites you to experience Music City in style. Also enjoy Tito’s Mexican Restaurant and Bar located on the first floor of the building.

The space
The main bedroom provides a king bed, an attached bathroom and a tv. The second bedroom has two twins that can convert to a king with the provided mattress joiner with a full bathroom steps away. A request to convert to king must be made at the time of booking. Our cleaning crew will set this up previous to your arrival. The living room boasts a queen sofa bed and a tv.

Guest access
You will have access to free parking, and outdoor pool and fitness room in the building.

Other things to note
If you want to convert the twin beds to king please contact us when you book. That will inform our cleaning crew to prepare the unit for your needs.
